stories.headline: Anthropic Q3 revenue surges 45% to 16.8 billion dollars as AI startup gears up for 2 trillion dollars IPO
stories.script: Our lead story today. Anthropic reported a 45% increase in revenue for the third quarter, reaching 16.8 billion dollars . The company's revenue for the first and second quarters was 4.7 billion dollars and 11.6 billion dollars , respectively. Anthropic aims for a valuation exceeding 2 trillion dollars , emphasizing substantial revenue growth despite significant operational losses. Founded by former OpenAI executives, the company focuses on AI safety amid growing competition.

stories.headline: Amazon’s Bee launches two new personal AI devices, starting at 75 dollars
stories.script: Also today. Amazon-owned Bee has launched its first new AI devices since its acquisition, including an updated wearable and a credit-card-sized recorder that attaches to smartphones. The devices can summarize conversations, create to-do lists, and integrate with Alexa and Amazon shopping, with prices starting at 74.99.

stories.headline: Your secrets aren’t safe with this cute robot toy they’re on Chinese servers ready to be hacked
stories.script: In China. But if you or your kids talk to "Eiliko" over Wi-Fi, it'll phone home to China. Its AI companion can store literally everything you tell it on Chinese servers, where hackers can easily gain access or even hijack its personality. And the company that made it, Energize Lab , doesn't seem to care. I bought an Eiliko from Amazon on August 29th. During a 10-minute conversation on August 30th, I asked the little bot: "Do you ever tell anybody else what I'm saying?" "Your secrets are safe with me," it replied.

stories.headline: How Windows is being optimized for Nvidia’s RTX Spark laptops
stories.script: Turning to the United States. Microsoft and Nvidia held a launch party for the first wave of RTX Spark laptops last week in San Francisco, where a new wave of AI PCs took center stage amid a packed crowd and a lively hands-on area. A day after the media event, I was invited to a quieter Nvidia event to hear a lot more about the new RTX Spark computing platform. While Nvidia's new laptops might look like regular Windows machines, the chips inside are Arm-based, instead of the traditional x64 architecture used by AMD and Intel. stories.script: Next. James is among 40 bipartisan AGs who filed a notice of interest in Character.AI's bankruptcy case "to put all parties on notice of the regulatory issues that will need to be addressed in any sale or transfer of the Debtor's business or assets."
